title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows and improve cache parallelism
author: Asha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Our repo has accumulated many near-duplicate GitHub Actions workflows for linting, testing, and release automation over the last 24 months. This causes long maintenance cycles, duplicated steps, inconsistent cache keys, and fragmented telemetry. This PR consolidates the lint/test/release pipelines into a smaller set of maintainable workflows, standardizes cache keys across OS/matrix axes, upgrades key actions, and applies a few targeted fixes for flaky CI jobs.

What this PR does (high level):
- Introduces a shared .github/workflows/common.yml to hold reusable job steps and annotated inputs (setup-node, checkout, install dependencies, restore/save cache, common env).
- Consolidates six repo workflows into three: lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml. Each uses clearly scoped matrices and reuses steps from common.yml via workflow_call.
- Improves cache key hygiene: runnerOS-<hash(lockfiles)>-node-modules-<node-version> to avoid cross-OS collisions. Bumped actions/cache to actions/cache@v4.
- Pins Node to 20.x across workflows and simplifies matrix by splitting long-running node versions into a curated set for lint only.
- Adds run-name and workflow tags (repo:ci, team:infra) for easier filtering in the console and metrics.
- Adds targeted retry and timeout adjustments for TestXYZ which was the main flaky test in CI.
- Small package.json devDependency bumps for @eslint/* and jest to resolve security lint reports and restore build caching behavior.

Checklist: 
- [x] Consolidate workflows and remove redundant files.
- [x] Upgrade actions/cache to v4 and fix cache keys.
- [x] Pin node-version to 20.x in CI.
- [x] Add workflow tags and run-name for observability.
- [x] Fix flaky TestXYZ with retry and timeout.
- [x] Update docs/ci.md to describe the new layout.

Impact: Expected median CI wall time improvement ~20-30% for PRs with modest test suites due to fewer duplicate steps and improved cache hit rates. Release automation now has a clearer dry-run path and fewer duplicated artifact upload steps.

Risk & mitigation: The biggest risk is introducing an inaccurate cache key that reduces cache hits or cross-contaminates modules across OS matrices. Mitigations: conservative key (includes OS and hash of yarn.lock/package-lock.json), staged rollout (merged with rollout flag toggled on), monitoring dashboards updated to detect cache hit-rate regressions.

Related: Linear ENG-9621 (CI hygiene and workflow consolidation), ENG-9602 (fix flaky test XYZ), SUP-874 (support-reported release automation timeout).

release_notes:
- Consolidated GitHub Actions workflows: lint/test/release now reuse a common workflow_call entrypoint to reduce duplication.
- Improved caching: actions/cache@v4 and standardized cache keys (runnerOS + lockfile-hash + node-version).
- Pinned CI to Node 20.x and reduced lint matrix to curated nodes.
- Fixed flaky TestXYZ with retry and timeout adjustments.
- Added run-name and workflow tags for better observability.
